name: zturret_runtime_has_active_node
description: zTurret_Runtime::HasActiveNode returns whether the runtime is initialized and its turret world node has the active flag set.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x436e20 compares runtime flags at offset 0, tests turretNode->flags bit 0x04 through offset 0x08 then node offset 0x24, returns 1 only when both are true, otherwise returns 0.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x436e20 has no function or address warnings; direct callees are empty.
The native smoke verifies false for inactive runtime flags, false for an inactive turret node, and true when both runtime flags and the turret node active bit are set.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x436e20 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
